title: PAIN RELIEF (ACETAMINOPHEN) TABLET, COATED [DISCOUNT DRUG MART]

sections.label: Indications and Usage
sections.title: Uses
sections.text:
temporarily relieves minor aches and pains due to:

the common cold
headache
backache
minor pain of arthritis
toothache
muscular aches
premenstrual and menstrual cramps

temporarily reduces fever

sections.label: Unclassified
sections.title: Liver warning
sections.text:
This product contains acetaminophen. Severe liver damage may occur if you take

more than 4,000 mg of acetaminophen in 24 hours
with other drugs containing acetaminophen
3 or more alcoholic drinks every day while using this product

sections.label: Unclassified
sections.title: Allergy alert
sections.text:
acetaminophen may cause severe skin reactions. Symptoms may include:

skin reddening
blisters
rash

If a skin reaction occurs, stop use and seek medical help right away.

sections.label: Do not use
sections.title: Do not use
sections.text:
with any other drug containing acetaminophen (prescription or nonprescription). If you are not sure whether a drug contains acetaminophen, ask a doctor or pharmacist.
if you are allergic to acetaminophen or any of the inactive ingredients in this product

sections.label: OTC - ASK DOCTOR SECTION
sections.title: OTC - ASK DOCTOR SECTION
sections.text: Ask a doctor before use if you have liver disease.

sections.label: OTC - ASK DOCTOR/PHARMACIST SECTION
sections.title: OTC - ASK DOCTOR/PHARMACIST SECTION
sections.text: Ask a doctor or pharmacist before use if you are taking the blood thinning drug warfarin

sections.label: Stop use and ask a doctor if
sections.title: Stop use and ask a doctor if
sections.text:
pain gets worse or lasts more than 10 days
fever gets worse or lasts more than 3 days
new symptoms occur
redness or swelling is present

These could be signs of a serious condition.

sections.label: OTC - PREGNANCY OR BREAST FEEDING SECTION
sections.title: OTC - PREGNANCY OR BREAST FEEDING SECTION
sections.text: If pregnant or breast-feeding, ask a health professional before use.

sections.label: Unclassified
sections.title: Overdose warning
sections.text: In case of overdose, get medical help or contact a Poison Control Center right away (1-800-222-1222). Quick medical attention is critical for adults as well as for children even if you do not notice any signs or symptoms.

sections.label: Dosage and Administration
sections.title: Directions
sections.text:
do not take more than directed (see 

 overdose warning)

adults and children 12 years and over | 

take 2 caplets every 6 hours while symptoms last
swallow whole – do not crush, chew, or dissolve
do not take more than 6 caplets in 24 hours, unless directed by a doctor
do not use for more than 10 days unless directed by a doctor

 | 

children under 12 years | 

ask a doctor

 |

sections.label: Other information
sections.title: Other information
sections.text:
store between 20-25°C (68-77°F)
retain carton for complete product information

sections.label: Inactive ingredients
sections.title: Inactive ingredients
sections.text: acesulfame potassium, flavor, hypromellose, polyethylene glycol, povidone, pregelatinized starch, propylene glycol, sodium starch glycolate, stearic acid, titanium dioxide
